title: Divergence register (ADR-006), format 1
description: Accepted differences between the PoB oracle and the successor. Documents the contract; `loom-parity-cli divergence-check` enforces it, including the rules this schema cannot express: ids unique, at most one accepted entry per fixture and field, `oracle_value` and `successor_value` not equal for an `exact` entry, a valid JSON pointer under a compared root. See docs/parity/README.md.

id.description: DIV- and four digits; unique, never reused.

mechanic.description: The game mechanic the difference is about.

fixture.description: A fixture id (its file name) or sha256:<hex> of its bytes.

field.description: JSON pointer (RFC 6901) into the output document under a compared root.

comparison.description: exact: both values must be the registered ones. abs / rel: numbers within the tolerance (|l - r| <= t, or <= t * max(|l|, |r|)).

oracle_value.description: The oracle's (left) value; null when the field is absent there.

successor_value.description: The successor's (right) value; null when the field is absent there.

kind.description: game-truth: the game behaves as the successor computes (game evidence required, ADR-001). pob-bug: a PoB defect. data-version: game data differs. harness: caused by the harness.

test.description: The test that pins the difference.

status.description: accepted entries cover differences; retired ones are kept for history.
